compiled_state.title: T6: Rebuild all 10 agent files via build-review-agents.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: UPDATE

Rebuild all 10 code-reviewer agent files after T2, T3, T4 delta changes are committed.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md (10 files, all regenerated)

## Dependencies
Must run AFTER T2, T3, T4 are committed.

## Steps

1. Run: bash plugins/dso/scripts/build-review-agents.sh

2. Verify 10 files rebuilt:
   ls plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md | wc -l
   Expected: 10

3. Verify cited_lines present in all 10 files:
   grep -l 'cited_lines' plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md | wc -l
   Expected: 10

4. Verify all 4 required rubric sections present in each file:
   - ## Severity Calibration Rubric
   - ## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules
   - ## Diff-Boundary Discipline
   - ## Schema Enforcement (must contain cited_lines in JSON example)

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 10 files contain cited_lines in their Schema Enforcement section
- All 10 files contain all 4 rubric sections
- No manual edits to agent files — they must be entirely regenerated via build-review-agents.sh
